concerns_or_questions_summary: Poster received an RFE on an H-1B transfer, is unsure whether the new employer will let them work on the receipt and when the case will be approved. To avoid the 60-day unemployment problem they ask whether they can leave the US while waiting, and whether doing so would trigger the $100k H-1B fee.
